claims.object_text: cohesin-core complex; sister chromatid cohesion; chromosome segregation
claims.quote: It encodes a subunit of the cohesin-core complex that tethers sister chromatids together to ensure correct chromosome segregation in both mitosis and meiosis.

claims.object_text: gene transcription regulation and genome organization
claims.quote: As a member of the cohesin ring, SMC1A takes part in gene transcription regulation and genome organization;

claims.object_text: DNA Damage Repair (DDR) pathway; phosphorylated by ATM and ATR kinases
claims.quote: it participates in the DNA Damage Repair (DDR) pathway, being phosphorylated by Ataxia Telangiectasia Mutated (ATM) and Ataxia Telangiectasia and Rad3 Related (ATR) threonine/serine kinases.

claims.object_text: component of Recombination protein complex (RC-1) involved in DNA repair by recombination
claims.quote: It is also a component of the Recombination protein complex (RC-1) involved in DNA repair by recombination.
SMC1A pathogenic variants have been described in Cornelia de Lange syndrome (CdLS), a human rare disease,
SMC1A variants have been associated with epilepsy
SMC1A variants have been associated with epilepsy or resembling Rett syndrome phenotype.
SMC1A variants have been identified in several human cancers.
